title: Honey and Soy Glazed Chicken Thighs
subtitle: Sticky oven-roasted chicken thighs with ginger and sesame
excerpt: A simple soy, honey, and ginger marinade turns into a glossy glaze as the chicken roasts. Marinate for at least 30 minutes for the best flavour.
sourceNotes: Asian-British crossover. Soy and honey glazed chicken is a home-cooking staple across British and East Asian cuisines.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate overnight in the fridge for a deeper glaze.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 200 or gas 7. High heat helps the glaze caramelise.

content.text: Score the chicken thighs a few times before marinating so the glaze gets into the flesh. A high oven gives you sticky, caramelised skin.

items.prepNote: skin-on if possible, scored a few times

content.text: Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and chilli flakes in a bowl.
Score the chicken thighs 2 or 3 times through the skin. Add to the marinade and turn to coat. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220 degrees C. Place the chicken skin-side up in a single layer in the roasting tin. Pour over any remaining marinade.
Roast for 22 to 25 minutes until the skin is deep golden and caramelised.
Check the thickest piece is cooked through with no pink juices. Scatter over the spring onion and serve.

items.cause: Oven too hot or chicken cooked too long.
items.fix: Tent with foil if it colours too fast; check at 20 minutes.

items.cause: Too much liquid in the tin from the marinade pooling.
items.fix: Pour off excess liquid halfway through cooking.

items.symptom: Meat is not cooked through at the thickest point.
items.cause: Thighs were very large or oven ran cool.
items.fix: Return to oven for 5 more minutes and re-check juices.
